summary: 原生 AA 三条路线同日推进：derekchiang 的 EIP-8141 EOA 支持合并，rakita 的可组合交易 EIP（EIP-8175）合并，chunter-cb 的 EIP-8130 无许可 payer 合并。VitalikButerin 介绍 EF 用 DVT-lite 质押 72,000 ETH，希望机构一键做分布式质押。nerolation 提交 snap/2 以 BAL 修复状态的 EIP。

summary_en: All three native AA tracks moved the same day: derekchiang's EIP-8141 EOA support merged, rakita's Composable Transaction EIP (EIP-8175) merged, and chunter-cb's EIP-8130 permissionless payer merged. VitalikButerin said the EF is staking 72,000 ETH with DVT-lite, hoping to make distributed staking one click for institutions. nerolation submitted the snap/2 BAL based state healing EIP.
